themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with environments to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles detailing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being used to research, generate, and iterate on design concepts and user interfaces.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, employment, and the nature of work, including discussions on job displacement and creation.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in automating software testing processes, improving efficiency and quality assurance.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the features, performance, and costs of different AI tools available for research purposes.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the use of AI in various aspects of usability testing, including participant recruitment, analysis, and interface evaluation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of AI-generated personas or users for research and testing purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
